name: BACH_0167
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (73%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Both classes sit in the 90% conformal set, so in situ is not excluded [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 73%, InSitu 26% | Invasive leads; InSitu plausible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / 98th percentile | Not flagged; OOD percentile high |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive | Mostly supports Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 5, 9) · context · 75% neoplastic nuclei, above 97% of reference images · Measured [F7]
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 5, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Largest concept term, but failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 5, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Scores high; spot check only 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Near-typical score here; contribution slightly negative · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI -0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; mitoses and necrosis are Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- True class is InSitu: it is in the conformal set, and similar case BACH_0070 is InSitu.
- Mean nuclear area is at the reference minimum; cell measures cover only regions 1, 5, 9.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 6, 9**: confirm mitoses and necrosis; both failed the AI spot check.
2. **Regions 4, 8**: per-region invasive risk is low (7%, 3%); look for ducts or lymphocytes.
3. **Regions 3, 5**: check stromal invasion against myoepithelium; p63/calponin are drafted.
